name: De Beauvoir Conservation Area Article 4 Direction
description: Withdraws permitted development rights for alterations to dwellinghouses (GPDO Schedule 2 Part 1 Classes A, B, C, D, F and H) and for gates, fences, walls and exterior painting (Part 2 Classes A and C) on the properties within the De Beauvoir Conservation Area shown on the direction map, to preserve front garden walls, railings, door cases, original windows and similar features.
notes: Made under article 4(1) of the GPDO 1995 on 7 July 2008 and approved by the Secretary of State on 27 November 2008 (approval date used as the start date; the notice of approval says the direction takes effect when that notice is served on owners and occupiers). Covers only the properties inside the dashed blue line on the direction map, not the whole conservation area. Document URL is the council's copy of the sealed direction with the Secretary of State's approval (Google Drive, linked from the documentation page); notice of approval: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1BvGT_HRDFS6cGKXC_SpyplONJiXK1VRm.

name: Chesham Arms Public House Article 4 Direction
description: Immediate direction withdrawing permitted development rights for change of use of the Chesham Arms public house, 15 Mehetabel Road, London E9 6DU, from Class A4 (drinking establishment) to Class A1 (shops), A2 (financial and professional services) or A3 (restaurants and cafes).
notes: Made with immediate effect on 4 March 2015 under the GPDO 1995 (Part 3 Classes A, AA and C, being Classes A, B and C of Part 3 of the GPDO 2015) and confirmed by Cabinet decision of 20 July 2015, confirmation dated 2 September 2015. End date: the national permitted development rights for change of use from drinking establishments were removed on 23 May 2017 by SI 2017/619, since when the direction has had no effect; the council still lists it as in force. Document URL is the council's copy of the sealed direction and site plan (Google Drive, linked from the documentation page); notice of confirmation: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=10Hsui-iQGUZZY8y-SvPJ02WBM2D9F_4V; Cabinet confirmation report: https://hackney.moderngov.co.uk/documents/s43997/LHR%20L9%20Report%20and%20appendices%20-Chesham_Arms_A4D_Confirmation_Report.pdf.

name: Article 4 Direction: flexible town centre uses (town centres) 2015
description: Non-immediate direction withdrawing the Part 4 Class D permitted development right for temporary (up to two years) flexible changes of use between shops, financial and professional services, restaurants and cafes, drinking establishments, hot food takeaways, business, non-residential institution, assembly and leisure, betting office and pay day loan shop uses in Hackney's town centres and local shopping centres.
notes: Made 20 July 2015 (Cabinet decision LHR L13 of 22 June 2015) and confirmed 15 September 2016, when it came into force. No end date is recorded: Part 4 Class D still exists (substituted from 1 August 2021 to refer to Class E), although the use classes named in the direction were replaced by Class E on 1 September 2020, so the practical effect of the direction is uncertain. Document URL is the council's Cabinet report with the direction appended; sealed and confirmed direction (Local Plan examination document ED044): https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1-JgvkX0RIKSFd1xIMPaFwY7Mz_OYvC06. The direction is no longer described on the council's article 4 page.

name: Article 4 Direction: office to residential (priority employment areas and town centres) 2015
description: Non-immediate direction withdrawing the Class O permitted development right for change of use from offices (B1(a)) to dwellinghouses (C3) in Hackney's priority employment areas, the Hackney Central and Manor House area action plan areas and the Hackney Central and Stoke Newington district town centres.
notes: Made 20 July 2015 (Cabinet decision LHR L12 of 22 June 2015) and confirmed 15 September 2016, when it came into force. End date: Class O was revoked from 1 August 2021 and, under article 15(3) of SI 2021/428, article 4 directions withdrawing Class O continued to apply to the equivalent Class MA development only until 31 July 2022; the direction has had no effect since. Class E to residential change of use in Hackney is now controlled by the 2022 directions (A4D-2022-*). Document URL is the council's Cabinet report with the direction appended; sealed and confirmed direction (Local Plan examination document ED036): https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1-3groi0Tkr86cfJabMw9unzOfjrGPoQz. The direction is no longer described on the council's article 4 page.

name: Article 4 Direction: retail to residential (town centres) 2015
description: Non-immediate direction withdrawing the Class M permitted development right for change of use from shops (A1), financial and professional services (A2), betting offices and pay day loan shops to dwellinghouses (C3) in Hackney's major and district town centres and local shopping centres.
notes: Made 20 July 2015 (Cabinet decision LHR L11 of 22 June 2015) and confirmed 15 September 2016, when it came into force. End date: from 1 August 2021 (SI 2021/428) Class M no longer permits change of use from shops or financial and professional services (now Class E) to dwellinghouses, so this direction has had no effect since; Class E to residential change of use is now controlled by the 2022 directions (A4D-2022-*). Document URL is the council's Cabinet report with the direction appended; sealed and confirmed direction (Local Plan examination document ED043): https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1-GKRr0d3tRlRUjP4xNzrOEPBZUosY49J. The direction is no longer described on the council's article 4 page.

name: Article 4 Direction: launderettes to residential 2017
description: Non-immediate direction withdrawing the Class M permitted development right for change of use from launderette to dwellinghouses (C3), and associated building operations, at 14 launderettes outside conservation areas across the borough.
notes: Made 1 May 2017 (Cabinet decision of 27 March 2017), confirmed 3 May 2018 (seal dated 14 May 2018) and in force from 14 May 2018. Class M still permits launderette to dwellinghouse change of use, so the direction remains in effect. A fifteenth launderette, 16 Stamford Hill, was added by the January 2018 direction A4D-2018-RETAIL-LAUNDERETTE-TO-RESIDENTIAL. Document URL is the council's Cabinet report (NH N65) with the direction appended; sealed and confirmed direction (Google Drive, linked from the documentation page): https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1-cCuEA17HkS0u6mFpvlU1d4uYoCoDnlv; notice of confirmation: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1-1IT1h4hLH_RnoCCJABEnaXkVzL-6Yon. UPRNs from OS Places.

name: Article 4 Direction: light industrial to residential 2017
description: Non-immediate direction covering the whole borough, withdrawing the Class PA permitted development right for change of use from light industrial (B1(c)) to dwellinghouses (C3).
notes: Made 1 May 2017 (Cabinet decision NH N67 of 27 March 2017), confirmed 3 May 2018 and in force from 14 May 2018. End date: Class PA only permitted development with a prior approval date before 1 October 2020 (GPDO Schedule 2 Part 3 paragraph PA.1(c)) and was revoked from 1 August 2021, so the direction has had no effect since 30 September 2020. Document URL is the council's Cabinet report with the direction appended; sealed direction (Local Plan examination document ED037): https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1-nEJN87MoyNHod-IWwkH7zJ3bw6FP62s; notice of confirmation: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=109MPYh5JQic0cM-4vi6CvpAFAtxe7HAM (linked from the council's page under the storage and distribution heading). The direction is no longer described on the council's article 4 page.

name: Article 4 Direction: storage and distribution to residential 2017

name: Article 4 Direction: flexible town centre uses (additional town centres) 2018

name: Article 4 Direction: office to residential (exemption area) 2018
description: Non-immediate direction withdrawing the Class O permitted development right for change of use from offices (B1(a)) to dwellinghouses (C3) in the former government exemption area covering Shoreditch, Hoxton, Dalston and Hackney Central, and the De Beauvoir priority industrial area.

Class E to residential change of use in Hackney is now controlled by the 2022 directions (A4D-2022-*). Document URL is the council's Cabinet report with the direction appended; the sealed copy formerly published on hackney.gov.uk is no longer online. The direction is no longer described on the council's article 4 page.

name: Article 4 Direction: retail and launderette to residential (additional town centres) 2018
description: Non-immediate direction withdrawing the Class M permitted development right for change of use from shops (A1), financial and professional services (A2), betting offices, pay day loan shops and launderettes to dwellinghouses (C3) in the additional town centre areas proposed in Local Plan 33 (east of Dalston, additions to Hackney Central, and the Dunsmure Road, Oldhill Street, Green Lanes and Hackney Downs local shopping centres) and at the launderette at 16 Stamford Hill.
